en.title: Y
en.summary: The letter Y is the twenty-sixth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter Y
paragraphs: The name of this letter is /j/ or /i/. Its main sound is heard in (yoga) /ˈjo.ɡo/, which means yoga. Romanian borrowed this letter for foreign words. It makes two sounds in total.

sections.title: Pronouncing the sounds
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the middle of your tongue high toward the roof of your mouth. Keep your lips relaxed and let your vocal cords vibrate. For the second sound, spread your lips wide into a smile. Raise your tongue high and forward. Put a hand on your throat to feel the steady vibration.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter appears only in borrowed words. Before another vowel, it sounds like the sound /j/, as in (yankeu) /janˈkew/. When it acts as a vowel, it sounds like the sound /i/, as in (hobby) /ˈxo.bi/.

sections.title: Common pitfalls
paragraphs: This letter matches English habits very closely. Do not turn the vowel sound into the sound in happy. Keep the sound clear and steady, like the vowel in see.
